About these horoscope readings

The reading above is a general one for your sign and the date you picked. It is the same for everyone born under that sign, because a sun-sign horoscope works from a single fact — which sign the Sun was in when you were born — and nothing else about you.

How these readings are produced

Each one is generated for a sign and a date from a set of themes written for the twelve signs across love, career, money and health. They are meant as a short daily prompt to think with, not a forecast of events, and we would rather say that plainly than imply a precision they do not have.

What a sun sign can and cannot tell you

A sun sign is one placement out of a whole chart. The ascendant, the position of the Moon, the houses each planet falls in and the dasha period you are currently running are what an astrologer actually reads, and none of them appear in a horoscope that only knows your birth month. That is why two people with the same sign recognise completely different things in the same reading.

When you want something specific to you

For a question about your own circumstances — a decision at work, a relationship, the timing of something — the reading has to come from your own chart. An online Kundli reading goes through your planetary positions, houses and current dasha with an astrologer who can explain what each one means for the thing you are asking about. For marriage, kundli matching compares two charts rather than two signs.

Is a daily horoscope the same as a Kundli reading?

No, and the gap is a large one. A horoscope works from your sun sign alone. A Kundli reading works from your date, time and place of birth, which is what gives the ascendant, the house positions and the dasha periods — the parts any reading of your own life actually rests on.

Why does my horoscope not match my day?

Because it was not written about you. A sign-level reading applies to roughly a twelfth of everyone, so the parts that fit are the parts that happen to overlap with your circumstances. Anything that accounts for your own chart needs a consultation.

Which zodiac does this page use?

The signs here follow the Western tropical zodiac, which is what most people mean by their star sign. Vedic astrology, which is what the astrologers on Astrowani practise, uses the sidereal zodiac — so your Vedic Moon sign is often a different sign altogether. You can work yours out with the free Rashi calculator.
